questions.question: What did Job remember in chapter 29?
options: The hidden sins of his youth
The counsel his friends had given
His former days of blessing and honor
The days yet to come after death
questions.answer: His former days of blessing and honor

questions.question: How did Job describe his former treatment of the needy?
options: He taxed the poor far beyond their slender means
He oppressed the weak and all the helpless among them
He ignored all of the needy who sat at his gate
He delivered the poor, the fatherless, and the widow
questions.answer: He delivered the poor, the fatherless, and the widow
